tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phrin las mgon po'i mnga' gsol bstan srung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma he ru ka ya/ kyai padma dbang gi bka' nyan cing / /srid zhi'i dregs pa ma lus pa/ /kun gyi gtso bo gnod sbyin che/ /kun khyab gsang mtshan drag rtsal dgongs su gsol/ /tse'u rgya gar yul gyi mtshan dmar po dgongs su gsol/ /mthu ldan lha bod yul gyi mtshan rnying pa btsan dgongs su gsol/ /de ring khyed la mnga' gsol lo/ /gnod sbyin chen por dpangs bstod do/ /sngon tshe padma dbang chen gyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /gnod sbyin chen por dpangs bstod do/ /rgya gar dur khrod me 'bar du/ /rgyal dbang padmas dam la btags/ /dam can chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /dus kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phrin las pho nya mdzad pa'i phyir/ /pho nya chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /mi 'gyur sku mdog smug nag zhal/ /gtum drag rngams pa srin po'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /dbu 'phang bstod dang bsrung ba'i phyir/ /srung ma chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /bse rmog me 'od 'bar ba dang / /bse khrab sdigs pa'i lus can gsol/ che btsan chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen po༞ /bstan dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i phyir/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar phyogs bcur 'phyar/ /dpal mgon chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /dbang drag las rnams sgrub pa'i phyir/ /g.yon pa btsan zhags dmar po bsnams/ /btsan rgod chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /stag ral gzig shubs la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo'i chas kyis rnam par bkra/ /mthu stobs chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /gang bcol phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir/ /zhabs la sag lh+wam yu ring gsol/ /'phrin las mgon po༞ /gnod sbyin chen༞

/rig 'dzin tshe dpal bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mu man byu ru'i do shal 'phyang / /gzi brjid chen por mnga'༞ /gnod sbyin chen por dpangs bstod do/ /snang srid chos kun gsal ba'i phyir/ /dngul dkar me long thugs kar mdzes/ /ye shes chen por mnga'༞ /gnod sbyin chen po༞ /stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /myur mgyogs chen po mnga'༞ /gnod sbyin chen por dpangs༞ /khams gsum srog la dbang bsgyur phyir/ /'khor du dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /srog bdag chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin bcas/ /bu bzhin skyong ba'i ngang tshul can/ /dam tshig chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por dpangs bstod do/ /lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas rnams dang / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs nas/ /ri dang rgya mtsho mnyam pa ru/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /khyed kyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /'di ltar khyed la mnga' gsol bas/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang mchog /ri rab rtse ltar mtho bar mdzod/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bum pa bzang po lta bur mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa'i don/ /'dod 'jo'i ba mchog bzhin du mdzod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi bcol ba'i las/ /ma rmos lo thog lta bur mdzod/ /mdor na rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka'/ /bstan srung khyed kyis khas blangs bzhin/ /gnas skabs mthar thug re smon kun/ /yid bzhin nor bu khyed kyis stsol/ /ces gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar po'i mnga' gsol 'di yang mes prang rje drung skal bzang mthu stobs sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po dang ldan pa gang de'i bzhed don du sa skya pa kun blos mgyogs par sbyar// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \*
